course_outcome.action: Analyze constrained choices using core economic concepts.
course_outcome.success_criterion: Correct analysis of three varied cases.

concepts.title: Opportunity cost
concepts.success_criterion: Two varied cases with complete reasons.
concepts.core_model: The value of the next-best alternative forgone.
concepts.example: Studying instead of the preferred paid shift.
concepts.non_example: Adding the value of every rejected alternative.
misconceptions: The money-valued option is always the opportunity cost.

assessment_items.prompt: Choose between a concert, a shift, and studying; identify the opportunity cost.
assessment_items.answer_key: The preferred next-best alternative, not all alternatives combined.
